summary: Iteration 2 — Admin panel testing (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/15 admin tests PASS (auth+role gating, /admin/statuses, product CRUD with 404s, order list/status/PATCH with 422 for invalid status, invoice CSV with 'Facture,Leray-Pointel' and 'Total HT', /admin/orders/export). Regression: 29/30 previous tests pass; single pre-existing failure test_list_products_15 expects exactly 15 products but 16 exist (leftover from prior manual admin creation via UI/DB) — NOT a regression from admin panel. Frontend: admin@leray-pointel.fr logs in and is routed to /(admin) dashboard showing KPIs (6 Commandes, 4 En attente, 264.40 € CA) and 3 action rows; nav-orders navigates to /orders (6 orders with status chips and invoice buttons); status modal opens and updating to 'Validée' works with success toast; nav-products lists 15 products with edit + delete buttons; add-product-btn opens product-edit form (Nouveau produit) with all fields; regular user (test@leray.fr) lands on (app) catalogue and cannot access /(admin) (AuthGate redirects). Admin logout icon works via testID 'admin-logout'. No deprecated Expo packages, no red screen, no CORS/network errors on core flows.

minor.issue: Regression test test_list_products_15 fails because DB now has 16 products (test data hygiene: not a code bug). Consider updating the assertion to '>=15' or seeding a fresh DB before running.

action_items: (Optional) Fix test_list_products_15 hygiene: reset test DB or change assertion to '>=15' since admin can now add products.

(Optional) Add testIDs on product-edit form inputs (e.g. product-name-input, product-category-input, product-price-input, product-save-btn) to make future automated tests more robust — form works but is currently only reachable via visual placeholders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — consider migrating to lifespan handlers.

login.tsx always calls router.replace('/(app)') after signIn; the AuthGate in _layout.tsx correctly re-routes admins to /(admin), so this works, but it triggers a brief double navigation. Could redirect based on user.role directly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 admin) / 96.7% (29/30 total incl. pre-existing test_list_products_15 stale-data failure)

seed_data_creation: None. Admin account is auto-seeded by server startup. Tests use test@leray.fr / Test1234! (registered if missing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel iteration 2 verified end-to-end on public URL. If running full backend suite, expect test_list_products_15 to fail with 16 products; that assertion is stale, not a code bug. Frontend admin routes: /(admin), /orders, /products, /product-edit. Admin key testIDs: nav-orders, nav-products, nav-export, admin-logout, add-product-btn, edit-{id}, delete-{id}, status-{id}, set-status-{Statut}, invoice-{id}, confirm-delete, back-btn.
rca_of_issue: test_list_products_15 pre-existing failure — root cause: DB has an extra product (either seeded twice historically or created via admin UI in a prior manual session). Not related to this iteration's changes. Mitigation: either drop products collection and let seed run, or relax the assertion to >=15.
